title: 第17章 手撕秘境第18章 手撕秘境二
slug: 黑化后我称霸三千大世界
lines: 随着时间的流逝，真龙秘境所照射的光芒不断的消减，而步入眼帘的是一个如同仙境一般的世界入口，入口里面是所显现的是一个仙气飘飘，灵气化液，整座大山都被浓密的灵气所覆盖
各种高阶灵草都长在灵河旁边，开启灵智的妖兽比比皆是，还有各种远古凶兽
“天哪，这是秘境吗？这是仙境吧”
真龙秘境外的人都惊讶的看着秘境内，眼神中充满了贪婪与欲望
“都是我的，兄弟们冲啊”
随着冲锋号响起，数万修士纷纷融入真龙秘境中，生怕机缘被他人抢了
“六公主，我们也进去吧”
一旁的薛统领看着风雪玲道，一把法剑握在手中，随时掩护风雪玲进秘境中
“好，我们现在进去吧”
风雪玲盯着虚空后，发现还是没有看见宫殿的影子，便失望的转头望向真龙秘境道
“天老，他们都进去了，我们也进去吧”
叶辰看着无数的修士陆陆续续的冲进真龙秘境中道，内心早已按耐不住了
“不急，先让子弹再飞一会儿，我们后面再上，真龙秘境中的凶兽已经很久没有见到人类了，心中的嗜血肯定也按耐不住了，先让这些人进去跟那些凶兽打一阵子吧”
天老的灵魂出现在叶辰的身旁摸着胡须道
“傲，我明白了天老，想不到你还是这么腹黑的人呐”
叶辰看着如此天老笑着道，内心更是对天老佩服
“嗯~孺子可教也，我们就是要趁乱进入秘境深处，先抢占先机，这样里面的机缘都是我们的了”
天老看着秘境内深意的道，现在秘境内已经有打起来了，四处都是凶兽的吼声与修士的弑杀声
场景可谓是极其的惨烈啊，这才进不到一盏茶的时间，就已经有近百名金丹修士陨落，筑基修士更是死伤无数
虚空中
宫殿逐渐的出现在虚空中，庞大的座驾如宫殿一般出现在真龙秘境上空，座驾前的八头上古麒麟开始狂躁，不断的向下散发威压
“嗯？这个凶兽的吼声从哪来的？为何不断的有威压产生”
真龙秘境外的的一些宗门长老被突如其来的吼声震惊到了，纷纷看向天空道
“是啊，来的时候天空还是很平静的，怎么秘境一开始，所有的动静都出现了”
“不行，我得上去看看是怎么回事，不能让这个动静影响到弟子的历练”
于是开始有几个元婴期的宗门长老纷纷往上飞，想看看是怎么回事
而后当他们飞到一定的程度的时候，所看见的是八只狮头，鹿角，虎眼，麋身，龙鳞，牛尾的麒麟，它们身高百米，庞大的身躯使它们看的更像似八座大山，正以血色般的眼神看着自己，粗大的獠牙露了出来，整张血盘大口张开，随时准备吃了他们
“这.....这......这为何会有远古麒麟啊，还是八头”
其中一名长来看着眼前的凶兽麒麟，顿时惊慌的指着道，整个身子不断的向后退，生怕自己被眼前的麒麟一口吞了
“情况不对，我们快走，不然我们都会死在它们口中”
一长老提意见道，开始调动体内的所有灵气，准备一口气逃离这里
八头上古麒麟见状开始向着天空发出阵阵震耳欲聋的吼声，顿时对这几个长老产生了眩晕的效果
于是前面四头上古麒麟张开血盆大口咬向眼前的几个人类
恢复过来的长老看着逼近的血盆大口惊慌的大喊道，不敢相信自己就这么陨落了
座驾内
“神子，真龙秘境已经开启了，现在已经有很多修士与秘境内的凶兽弑杀了”
content_en:
As time goes by, the light illuminated by the True Dragon Secret Realm continues to diminish, and what comes into view is the entrance to a world like a fairyland. What appears inside the entrance is a floating fairy energy, the spiritual energy turns into liquid, and the entire mountain is covered by dense spiritual energy.
All kinds of high-level spiritual grasses grow beside the Linghe River, and there are many monsters that can activate spiritual intelligence, as well as various ancient ferocious beasts.
"Oh my God, is this a secret realm? Is this a fairyland?"
People outside the True Dragon Secret Realm looked at the secret realm in surprise, their eyes filled with greed and desire.
"It's all mine, brothers, come on"
As the charge horn sounded, tens of thousands of monks merged into the True Dragon Secret Realm, fearing that the opportunity would be snatched away by others.
"Sixth Princess, let's go in too."
Commander Xue on the side looked at Feng Xueling and said, holding a magic sword in his hand, ready to protect Feng Xueling when she enters the secret realm.
"Okay, let's go in now"
After Feng Xueling stared into the void, she found that she still didn't see the shadow of the palace, so she turned around in disappointment and looked at the True Dragon Secret Realm Road.
"God, they've all gone in, let's go in too"
Ye Chen watched countless monks rush into the middle of the True Dragon Secret Realm one after another, and he couldn't hold it in anymore.
"No rush, let the bullets fly for a while, and we will come up later. The ferocious beasts in the True Dragon Secret Realm have not seen humans for a long time, and the bloodthirsty in their hearts must be unbearable. Let these people go in and fight those ferocious beasts for a while."
Tianlao's soul appeared next to Ye Chen, stroking his beard and saying
"Ao, I understand. God, I didn't expect you to be such a sinister person."
Ye Chen looked at Tianlao like this and said with a smile, and he admired Tianlao even more in his heart.
"Well, you can teach me, we just need to take advantage of the chaos to enter the depths of the secret realm and seize the opportunity first, so that all the opportunities inside are ours."
Tianlao looked at the secret realm and said meaningfully, now there is a fight in the secret realm, and there are the roars of ferocious beasts and the killing sounds of monks everywhere.
The scene was extremely tragic. In less than a cup of tea, nearly a hundred Golden Core cultivators had already died, and the Foundation Establishment cultivators suffered countless casualties.
in the void
The palace gradually appeared in the void, and a huge car appeared above the True Dragon Secret Realm like a palace. The eight-headed ancient unicorn in front of the car began to be manic, and continued to exude pressure downwards.
Roar! ! ! ! !
"Huh? Where does the roar of this ferocious beast come from? Why is there constant pressure?"
Some sect elders outside the True Dragon Secret Realm were shocked by the sudden roar and looked towards the sky.
"Yes, the sky was very calm when we came here. Why did all the movements appear when the secret realm started?"
"No, I have to go up and see what's going on. I can't let this movement affect the disciple's experience."
Then several sect elders in the Nascent Soul Stage began to fly upward, wanting to see what was going on.
Then when they flew to a certain level, what they saw were eight unicorns with lion heads, antlers, tiger eyes, elk bodies, dragon scales, and ox tails. They were hundreds of meters tall, and their huge bodies made them look more like eight mountains. They were looking at themselves with blood-colored eyes, their thick fangs exposed, and their whole blood plate opened wide, ready to eat them at any time.
"This...this...why is there an ancient unicorn, or an eight-headed one?"
One of the chiefs looked at the ferocious beast Qilin in front of him, and immediately pointed in panic, his whole body kept moving back, for fear that he would be swallowed by the Qilin in front of him.
"The situation is not right, let's leave quickly, otherwise we will all die in their mouths"
An elder suggested, and began to mobilize all the spiritual energy in his body, preparing to escape from here in one breath.
Roar! ! !
Upon seeing this, the ancient Qilin on the Eight Heads began to roar into the sky with deafening roars, which immediately had a dizzy effect on the elders.
So the four ancient unicorns in front opened their bloody mouths and bit the few humans in front of them.
"No!!!"
The elder who had recovered looked at the approaching blood basin and shouted in panic. He couldn't believe that he had fallen like this.
........
In the car
"Son of God, the True Dragon Secret Realm has been opened. Now many monks have killed the ferocious beasts in the secret realm."
